# Oboe source pin

Vendored unmodified `include/`, `src/`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `LICENSE` from Google's
Oboe tag 1.11.0, commit `b115f47593969fd67a21e9f63640ffef749b5067`.
Source: https://github.com/google/oboe/tree/1.11.0 . Apache-2.0.
Samples, tests, binaries and the upstream Git directory are not included.
No configure-time network fetch. Included in the application as a static library.
